notes.Katatonia: Tuning shifted from D standard (2003) to Drop Bb (2006) — significant downtuning between albums
notes.Dark Tranquillity: Conflict within Damage Done album (2002): title track tab says D standard, Monochromatic Stains tab says C# standard. Character (2005) confirmed C# standard.
notes.Avatar: Only 7 tabs on guitartabs.cc. Bloody Angel has explicit Drop B string labels. Limited coverage.
notes.Leprous: No tabs on guitartabs.cc. leprous.net has no FAQ/tuning section. UG is JS-only. Potential lead: YouTube tutorial descriptions (not fetched). Fan forums may have info.
notes.Enslaved: Ruun (2006) confirmed C# standard. Havenless (Below the Lights, 2003) shows unusual open C# tuning (strings 2-5 each +2 semitones from C# standard) — may be GP tab error or genuine open tuning.
notes.Stam1na: Official FAQ (stam1na.com/ukk/) states SLK 6-string songs use Ibanez Jem 77VBK but does NOT state 6-string tuning. Paha Arkkitehti (K18V/SLK 2014) tab says Drop D. SLK track list confirmed via Finnish Wikipedia.
notes.Wintersun: All guitartabs.cc tabs (Sadness and Hate, Starchild, Beyond the Dark Sun v4, Battle Against Time) show E standard. Jari Maenpaa plays standard tuning on debut album. Skipped per rules (no non-E-standard songs found).
notes.Children of Bodom: Are You Dead Yet? (2005) clearly in Drop C (C G C F A D). Banned from Heaven (HCDR 2003) also Drop C per tabber note. Angels Dont Kill conflict: one tab says C# standard but from a keyboard arrangement.
notes.Arch Enemy: Stigmata (1998): B standard ('Tune Down 2.5 steps to B'). Wages of Sin (2001): C standard ('Tune Gtr to C', confirmed by Burning Angel and Ravenous tabs).
